EVERY NUMBER, CHECKABLE AT THE SOURCE

A missed deadline has a known price.

01 · ISF FILING

Miss the 24-hour deadline

ISF must be filed at least 24 hours before lading. Miss it, and liquidated damages of USD 5,000 apply per violation.

Source: U.S. CBP · 19 CFR § 113.62 →

02 · D&D INVOICES

A 30-day window to dispute

Carriers must bill within 30 calendar days of the last charge, and you have at least 30 days to dispute. Your records are your evidence.

Source: U.S. FMC · final rule on D&D billing →

03 · ENTRY ERRORS

Up to 4× the unpaid duty

Gross negligence under 19 U.S.C. § 1592 means 4× the underpaid duty — or 40% of dutiable value where no revenue is lost.

Source: 19 U.S.C. § 1592 →
